abort.unique_id_mismatch: The machine at that address is not the machine of this entry.

error.not_a_zmorph: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Zmorph controller.

data_description.host: The name or address of the machine on your network. The firmware of the Zmorph Fab normally answers to the name fab.
data_description.port: The port of the machine web service. Leave 80 unless you know it listens somewhere else.

user.description: The machine does not have to be switched on. Home Assistant probes it slowly while it stays off, and picks up again as soon as it answers.
user.title: Connect to your Zmorph machine

data_description.host: The new name or address of the same machine.
data_description.port: The port of the machine web service.

invalid_probe_interval.message: The probe interval must be between 5 seconds and 24 hours.

max_below_min_probe_interval.message: The maximum probe interval must not be shorter than the minimum.

not_a_zmorph.message: {host} answered, but not with G-code. Check the address of the machine.

error.max_below_min: The maximum wait must be at least as long as the first wait.

data_description.max_probe_interval: The wait stops growing here, however long the machine stays off. The default is 1200 seconds, 20 minutes.
data_description.min_probe_interval: How long Home Assistant waits after a probe that reached nothing, doubled every silent probe after that. The default is 15 seconds: 15, 30, 60, 120, up to the maximum. The moment the machine answers, it goes back to this value.
